typography_policy: Visible lower hasanta is U+09CD. Before a separately printed following consonant, append U+200C ZWNJ to prevent Unicode shaping into an unprinted conventional ligature; this is a rendering preservation control, not a separate source glyph or phonological claim. Final hasanta uses U+09CD alone. Never insert hasanta solely from linguistic expectation or comparator analogy.
